rules: New heavy production asset loads must use soft references and asynchronous chapter/region loading; existing synchronous LoadObject debt may decrease but not grow.
Ambient/crowd NPC lifecycle must migrate to bounded object pooling; named persistent story NPC identity/state is not recycled through generic crowd pools.
New animated character/creature production assets use skeletal FBX. Legacy OBJ files are static/fallback debt only.
New authored texture sources use PNG/TGA. Final AO/roughness/metallic PBR masks are channel-packed where applicable; do not add new BMP source debt.
evidence_boundary: STATIC guardrails only; no compile, PIE, device, FPS/memory or visual acceptance is claimed.

baseline_capture.rule: Exact legacy inventory only. Any new file or count increase fails; reductions are allowed.
